target: y_error = int(frozen E1 claim-level prediction is not equal to authentic SUPPORT/CONTRADICT label)

cross_fitting.procedure: train on four folds and score only the held-out fold

statistics.tie_break: ascending SHA-256 of '20261015:claim_id', identical across methods
statistics.coverage: accepted claim count / eligible claim count
statistics.selective_risk: sum y_error among accepted / accepted count
statistics.aurc: arithmetic mean of prefix selective risks for k=1..n; no oracle normalization
statistics.success_rule: both paired 95% CIs have upper bound below 0; otherwise H1 is not supported

bootstrap.invalid_replicate_rule: record and omit only a secondary AUROC replicate lacking both y_error classes; risk/AURC replicates remain valid

prohibitions: train any risk model in Phase 2A
compute EARS/B1/B2/B0 selective performance in Phase 2A
